name: csoai-gspc-mcp
display_name: Council of AI — GSPC Measurement Tools
description: Independent AI-governance measurement body. Publishes the GSPC 14-slot instrument (Governance · Safety · Provenance · Continuity) with frozen item banks, published scoring code, and Ed25519-signed board. Measurement only: not certification, not accreditation, no conformity assessment.

mcp.note: Primary and fallback are canonical URLs once routed; current is the live worker endpoint.

gspc_board.description: Live Ed25519-signed GSPC 14-slot board (13 measured of 14): per-axis n, leader, Wilson interval, McNemar separation. No auth required.

authentication.note: Public MCP — initialize and tools/list require no Authorization header.
